title: phebalium squameum
intro: Phebalium squameum, commonly known as the scrub turpentine bush, is a plant species native to Australia, belonging to the Rutaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the reduction of inflammation and improvement of respiratory health, making it beneficial for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Phebalium squameum include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion, and as an antiseptic, aiding in wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
